Recent flow is strongly negative, the sell-to-buy ratio is 0.93 in the launch window and worse recently, and the bundle share of 33.6% signals coordinated early buying. A coin that has lost most of its value in 15 minutes, with sellers still dominant, is the profile where dip-buying has historically lost money. Fees of 1.4-5.1% are also a meaningful hurdle against a coin that needs a reversal to break even.

Verdict: I cannot make an honest case that real demand will persist here. Skip.
